stories.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney spoke with US President Donald Trump on Monday, as Ottawa scrambles to avert new 50% tariffs that take effect at midnight on Wednesday. A deal to avoid the duties sits on Trump’s desk, Politico reported, but one sticking point is US tariffs on Canadian vehicles. Carney described the negotiations as “ very delicate and intense ,” and Ottawa has warned Washington that the tariffs could jeopardize further trade talks : A breakdown of the US-Mexico-Canada Agreement could cost the US economy $1 trillion by 2035 , per one analysis. Around a third of Canadians favor a forceful response to Washington’s threats, according to a poll, and only 18% want to offer concessions like ending provincial bans on American alcohol. — Brendan Ruberry
